title: How to Download Facebook Videos to Your Phone Gallery
description: How to download Facebook videos to your Android or iPhone gallery without an app. Copy a public video link, paste it into I Need Save and pick a quality.
photoCaption: A video from a public Facebook post.
photo2Caption: Only public videos can be downloaded.
body:
Facebook is full of great videos, from recipes and gardening tips to match highlights and funny clips from your favorite groups. Unfortunately, there's no built-in button to save them straight to your gallery. In this article you'll learn how to download Facebook videos to your phone gallery using I Need Save, a free web-based tool that works without an app and without logging in.

What Do You Need?

There's very little to prepare:

  • A phone or computer with a browser and an internet connection.
  • A Facebook video link from a public post.
  • A bit of free storage on your device.

That's it. You don't need to create an account on I Need Save, and you don't need to enter your Facebook login details.

How to Download Facebook Videos on Your Phone

Follow these steps on either Android or iPhone:

  1. Open the Facebook app and find the video you want to save.
  2. Tap the Share button below the video.
  3. Choose Copy link.
  4. Open your browser and go to ineedsave.com.
  5. Paste the link into the box, or tap the Paste button.
  6. Press Download and wait for the list of options to appear.
  7. Pick the video quality you want. The download will begin.

For some videos, the button will show Preparing… first. This happens when the video needs processing, for example joining the video and audio, or converting a stream into MP4. Just wait, because the download starts automatically as soon as the file is ready.

How to Download Facebook Videos on a Computer

On a laptop or PC, the steps are similar. Open Facebook in your browser, click the video you want, then copy its link from the Share menu or the address bar. Open the downloader page in a new tab, paste the link, click Download and choose one of the available options. The file will be saved in your Downloads folder.

Why Download with I Need Save

  • Free and no app. Just open the site in the browser on your phone or computer.
  • No login. You never have to enter your Facebook account details anywhere.
  • Works for other platforms too. Besides Facebook, you can also save videos from TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) and several other supported platforms.
  • Easy to use. The interface is available in 93 languages, including English.

Choosing the Right Video Quality

Once the link is processed, I Need Save shows several options. What appears can differ from video to video:

  • Video in several qualities, such as 360p, 720p or 1080p, depending on the original video.
  • Audio in original quality or as a 192 kbps MP3 converted from the video.
  • Photo / Thumbnail from the video.

In general, 1080p gives the sharpest picture, 720p strikes a balance between quality and size, and 360p is the lightest on data and storage. You'll find a fuller explanation in our article on the difference between 360p, 720p and 1080p video quality.

Getting the Video into Your Phone Gallery

This is the part that often confuses people. After the download finishes, the video doesn't always show up in your gallery right away. Here's why.

On Android

The video is saved in the Downloads folder. The Gallery app will usually show it, but sometimes it takes a moment. If it isn't there yet, wait a little or open the Downloads folder with your file manager app.

On iPhone and iPad

If you download with Safari, the video goes to the Files app, in the Downloads folder. To move it to the Photos app:

  1. Open the Files app and go to the Downloads folder.
  2. Tap the video you just downloaded.
  3. Tap the Share button.
  4. Choose Save Video.

Now the video is in your gallery and plays like any other video. MP4 files from I Need Save have the correct duration, so they play smoothly in gallery apps.

Tip: If you download videos often, tidy up your Downloads folder regularly so your phone storage doesn't fill up too fast.

Facebook Video Won't Download?

Some kinds of content simply can't be fetched:

  • Videos from private accounts or groups.
  • Content that can only be viewed after logging in.
  • Videos restricted to certain regions.

Also make sure the link you paste is a video link, not a page or profile link. If in doubt, copy it again from the Share button on the video.

Safe and Responsible

Videos are streamed directly from Facebook to your device and are not stored on the I Need Save server. Even so, keep your downloads for personal use only. Respect the creator's copyright: ask for permission before reposting and give credit to the original owner.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I download Facebook videos without an app?

Yes. I Need Save runs right in your browser, so you don't need to install any app.

Why doesn't the video show up in my gallery right away?

On Android, the Gallery sometimes needs a moment to show new files. On iPhone, the video goes to the Files app first, and you need to choose Save Video to move it into Photos.

Can I save just the audio?

Yes. Choose the Audio option, either in original quality or as a 192 kbps MP3.
